# `jouet job start`

- **Usage:** `jouet job start [FLAGS] <ID> [-- CMD]…`

Start a command in the background and return once it is ready

Runs CMD (directly, not through a shell) in this directory, with stdin closed and stdout and stderr in the job's log. With --port, --http or --output, waits up to --timeout (default 60s) for the job to be ready and fails (exit 1) with the end of its log if it exits first; a job still not ready at the timeout keeps running (exit 124). Without one, it returns at once, unless the command fails straight away. Refuses (exit 4) while a job of the same ID runs, unless --replace stops it first.

## Arguments
- **`<ID>`** — The job's ID: letters, digits, `_`, `.` and `-`
- **`[-- CMD]…`** — The command and its arguments, after `--`

## Flags
- **`--port <N>`** — Ready once localhost's port N accepts connections
- **`--http <URL>`** — Ready once URL answers with a 2xx status
- **`-o --output <REGEX>`** — Ready once a line of the job's log matches REGEX
- **`--timeout <DUR>`** — How long to wait for the ready check (default 60s)
- **`--replace`** — Stop a running job of the same ID first
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
